description: Accept ordinary COOK language and print a parser-valid cast iron range name

replacements.old:
<SYNTAX WARM OBJECT ON OBJECT = V-KITCHEN-WARM-ON>
<SYNTAX HEAT OBJECT ON OBJECT = V-KITCHEN-WARM-ON>
<SYNTAX COOL OBJECT = V-KITCHEN-COOL>
replacements.new:
<SYNTAX WARM OBJECT ON OBJECT = V-KITCHEN-WARM-ON>
<SYNTAX HEAT OBJECT ON OBJECT = V-KITCHEN-WARM-ON>
<SYNTAX COOK OBJECT = V-KITCHEN-COOK>
<SYNTAX COOK OBJECT ON OBJECT = V-KITCHEN-WARM-ON>
<SYNTAX COOL OBJECT = V-KITCHEN-COOL>

<ROUTINE V-KITCHEN-COOK ()
    <COND (<NOT <KITCHEN-HERE?>>
           <TELL "The white-house Kitchen is where the cooking fixtures are." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,LUNCH>
           <COND (<IN? ,LUNCH ,KITCHEN-WORKTOP>
                  <V-KITCHEN-PREPARE>)
                 (<IN? ,LUNCH ,KITCHEN-RANGE>
                  <SETG PRSI ,KITCHEN-RANGE>
                  <V-KITCHEN-WARM-ON>)
                 (T
                  <TELL "Put the lunch on the worktop to prepare it, or on the hot range to cook it further." CR>)>)
          (<IN? ,PRSO ,KITCHEN-RANGE>
           <SETG PRSI ,KITCHEN-RANGE>
           <V-KITCHEN-WARM-ON>)
          (<KITCHEN-RANGE-ACCEPTS? ,PRSO>
           <TELL "Put the " D ,PRSO " on the cast iron range before cooking it." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,NEST>
           <TELL "The woven nest is not food and has no sensible cooking treatment here." CR>)
          (T
           <TELL "There is no sensible way to cook the " D ,PRSO " with the Kitchen fixtures." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE V-KITCHEN-WARM-ON ()
